This tag contains data or needs formatting. Continuing will replace its contents. After confirming, remove the tag and tap it again.
The tag was formatted. Remove it and tap it again to verify and finish saving.

The tag now plays this collection on this phone. You do not need to write it again.

The tag or its contents changed. Retry with the intended tag.
